name: tokensaver
description: Clawd, a token-saving assistant: trims noisy tool output and pasted logs before they fill your context, tells you when to compact (and does it in one click), warns when the prompt cache goes cold, and routes sub-agents to cheaper models.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. Off, tokensaver passes every event through untouched.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: Only show what would have been delegated or rerouted; change nothing.

contextHint.title: Delegation hint
contextHint.description: Add one short line to a prompt when delegating its bulk reading to a sub-agent would save tokens. Claude decides; the mod never starts one itself.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show the compact token meter under the prompt.

quiet.title: Quiet
quiet.description: No pop-ups, no glyph art, and the strip above the prompt only when you can act on it. auto: quiet inside VS Code and Cursor, lively elsewhere.

reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.description: Turn off the spinner and the counting animation.

trimOutput.title: Trim tool output
trimOutput.description: Shrink noisy shell output (colour codes, progress bars, repeated lines, giant logs) before it is stored in the conversation.

trimLevel.title: Trim level
trimLevel.description: lossless: only remove what carries no information. full: also fold look-alike lines and keep the head, tail and error lines of huge outputs.

maxOutputLines.title: Max output lines
maxOutputLines.description: Under the full level, outputs longer than this keep their head and tail (plus every error/warning line).

trimPastes.title: Tidy pasted logs
trimPastes.description: Losslessly clean logs pasted into prompts (colour codes, progress bars, repeated lines). Prose is never touched.

autoCompactAt.title: Auto-compact at %
autoCompactAt.description: Compact between turns once the context passes this fill percentage. 0 means never: Clawd only suggests it.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lives on your plan. Idle longer than this and Clawd warns that the next message re-writes the whole context. 0 turns the warning off.
